name: flow
description: The work flow: pick the next ready item, plan, implement, test, review, verify and open a PR, with agents in worktrees and human gates only where a human adds value.

codex.shortDescription: Run tracked work end to end
codex.longDescription: Picks the next ready item from the tracker, plans it to the right depth, implements and tests it in a worktree, reviews, verifies and opens a PR. Humans decide only at the gates.
defaultPrompt: Use $next to run the next ready item
Use $board to show what is running and waiting

skills.name: init
skills.shortDescription: Install the flow in a repo
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $init to install or refresh the flow plugin in this repository.

skills.name: next
skills.shortDescription: Run the next step of an item
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $next to run the next ready item through its flow.

skills.name: new
skills.shortDescription: Create an epic, task or bug
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $new to file a task, a bug or an epic in the tracker.

skills.name: do
skills.shortDescription: Say what you want in plain words
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $do to work on my backlog in plain words, for example: start the bots bug.

skills.name: help
skills.shortDescription: What the flow can do, like a man page
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $help to list what the flow can do and how to call it.

skills.name: gate
skills.shortDescription: See or answer the gates waiting on you
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $gate to list the gates waiting on me, or to approve one.

skills.name: board
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $board to show every worktree, item, gate and overlap.

skills.name: steward
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $steward to show the worktree pool and free a worktree.

skills.name: plan
skills.shortDescription: Plan, design or decompose an item
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $plan to plan this item to its profile's depth.

skills.name: implement
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $implement to implement this item in its worktree.

skills.name: test
skills.shortDescription: Write the tests from the acceptance lines
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $test to write the tests for this item.

skills.name: review
skills.shortDescription: Review an item's diff at its depth
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $review to review this item's diff against the standards and its spec.

skills.name: verify
skills.shortDescription: Build, format, tests, gates; one report
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $verify to verify this item and write the report.

skills.name: pr
skills.shortDescription: Open the PR with the house body
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $pr to open the pull request for this item.

skills.name: comments
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $comments to address the review comments on this PR.

skills.name: intake
skills.shortDescription: File the notes as typed items
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $intake to file my notes as items.

skills.name: explain
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $explain to explain this item's change and write the quiz.
